tool.name: plink_indeppairwise
tool.description: Produce a pruned subset of markers that are in approximate linkage equilibrium with each other. Pairs of variants in the current window with squared correlation greater than the threshold are noted and variants are greedily pruned from the window until no such pairs remain.

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**plink_indeppairwise**
Produce a pruned subset of markers that are in approximate linkage equilibrium with each other. Pairs of variants in the current window with squared correlation greater than the threshold are noted and variants are greedily pruned from the window until no such pairs remain.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: plink/indeppairwise - Container: biocontainers/plink:1.90b6.21--h779adbc_1
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
